items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It looked like it was Noltin or...

ctx.x: Do you know the type of music she was singing? Do you have any material from his European trips?
Her name sounds like Nolan. She used to be in America. She was an American singer once and she used to write him. It looked like it was Noltin or...
When was the first time you went to Europe? '58?
